(2) The scene cuts to the interior of an airplane cabin where the camera shakes violently to simulate turbulence; passengers are visible in their seats, and yellow captions appear on the screen. (3) Back in the terminal, the man speaks with an expressive facial expression while multiple semi-transparent overlays of the text "救命" (Help) float around his head in various sizes. (4) The man is shown seated inside the airplane cabin, looking directly into the lens with wide eyes and a concerned expression, with the plane's headrests and other passengers visible behind him. (5) A digital interface screenshot displays a news article about hail in Shanghai, featuring a purple flower image and text descriptions of weather alerts. (6) The man is seen in the terminal again, initially walking and then joyfully running toward the camera, which is being held in a selfie perspective as he moves through the spacious hall.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A young male voice starts speaking in Mandarin with an energetic and slightly anxious tone, detailing an experience with flight turbulence. A steady electronic synth beat with a 4/4 drum pattern plays in the background at a moderate volume. (2) A mechanical rustle and faint background murmurs from an airplane cabin are heard as the speaker's pitch rises, mimicking the stress of the event. The electronic BGM continues with high-frequency hi-hats. (3) The speaker's voice becomes more rapid and breathless, describing his prayers during the turbulence. The BGM remains consistent. (4) A short electronic notification sound pings. The speaker explains the flight's diversion due to hail in Shanghai, maintaining high vocal arousal. (5) The speaker's volume increases and he lets out a slight laugh while describing people running in the airport. The BGM reaches a steady loop and then cuts off abruptly at the end.
